costSummary.scope: Sum of completed outer guard wall durations includes failed attempts. Union merges overlapping intervals; neither is CPU time or total engineering time. Do not add nested request/profile/runtime durations to these totals. RSS and allocated-storage peaks are maxima, not additive totals; unrelated filesystem writers can affect disk observations.

verification: Complete gzip roundtrip and every included UTF-8 member size/SHA256 verified; all live captured member identities/content rechecked before publication.
